facts.title: Why is Samson's story even in the Bible?

items.msg: ASK THE TEXT

estimated 80s
'secret' — make sure the text really says this: 'He chased a Philistine wife, and told Delilah his secret after she tried to hand'
'only' — make sure the text really says this: 'Samson could only begin. Jesus said, "It is finished."'

answer stated in the Turn/Landing: 'Read beside the Gospels, Samson's life is a rough sketch of a Savior, and the places he failed are the places Jesus didn't. Samson could only begin to save. Jesus said, "It is finished."'
